title: SQLite runs WAL with synchronous=NORMAL, so a just-written position record can be lost on power loss or OS crash

evidence.ref: sed -n 19,23p of the base snapshot (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: lines re-read. Not reproduced. A process crash alone does not lose committed data; only power loss or OS failure does.

sibling_sites_checked: All critical writes (db.ts:320-323, :540-545, :631-652) use the same database handle and setting.
severity_rationale: S2: a power cut or OS crash in the small window after a buy is recorded, on a machine with no battery guarantee. The effect is a lost row for a real position. Linked at 22-28 to RC-14, whose text names synchronous=NORMAL under WAL; the RC is otherwise carried by AUD-DB-004. S2 is below the S1 suggestion because a loss here needs a host-level crash within the OS write-back window after a buy (a process crash cannot lose WAL commits).
recommendation: Decide whether critical writes need FULL durability in card DB-07. Phase 29 (S2-S4). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
